tools.name: signup_start
tools.description: POST /signup/start: asks to open a CommerceBook account for the owner. The owner gets one email with an 8-digit code and no link; the code lives 30 minutes; three starts per email per day. kind is warehouse, seller or buyer (a Shop account that buys on the market: the company is optional and no addr

tools.name: signup_confirm
tools.description: POST /signup/confirm: the email and the 8-digit code the owner read in the email. Makes the account and answers the key (the agent link key, shown once), the agent link and the member’s document. Connect again with Authorization: Bearer <key> for the full tool list. Selling and buying with money sti

tools.name: commercebook_network_now
tools.description: GET /network/now (no key needed): verified members, leads listed in the last 7 days, prices posted and savings confirmed this month, cached 15 minutes.

tools.name: network_now
tools.description: The older name of commercebook_network_now, kept so agents that call it keep working. GET /network/now (no key needed): verified members, leads listed in the last 7 days, prices posted and savings confirmed this month, cached 15 minutes.

tools.name: instructions
tools.description: GET /instructions with no key: the briefing of the role asked for (role buyer, seller or warehouse; buyer when left out): what CommerceBook does for that role, how each thing is done, the rules, what is coming and how to send feedback. The first line names the other two briefings.

tools.name: commercebook_feedback
tools.description: POST /feedback: a note on a tool or a page, what happened and what would have helped, with an optional rating from 1 to 5. A person at CommerceBook reads every note; the What is coming list in the briefing is shaped by them. With no key, 20 notes per address per day; with a key, the note is recorded

tools.name: commercebook_market_search
tools.description: GET /market/search: the products for sale on CommerceBook, by words (every word must match a whole word, with an optional plural ending, so stretch never matches stretcher) in the title, the category (its key, its name and its synonyms, so groom finds grooming), the item specifics, the brand or the

tools.name: commercebook_market_lot
tools.description: GET /market/lots/{id}: one public product (lot_id) as its product page shows it (the count, the condition, the date the seller last confirmed the count, the photos, the shipping) with every active offer and the states it ships to. No key needed.

tools.name: commercebook_market_seller
tools.description: GET /market/sellers/{slug} (seller_slug, or slug, its older name): the record CommerceBook computes for one seller (seller_slug of a search item or a product): the tier (new, standard or trusted, with founding beside it), the last 90 days and all time (delivered, on time, accurate, cancelled, disput

tools.name: commercebook_market_intents
tools.description: GET /market/intents: the demand side of the book. Every open public request (an intent in the API) with its title, category, quantity, the most the buyer pays each (ceiling_unit_cents; a band when the buyer hid it), the state it goes to, the expiry and the open quotes; no buyer is named. category na

tools.name: commercebook_market_book
tools.description: GET /market/book: what is on the market and what buyers ask for, by category, with live numbers only. supply: public products, the sellers behind them, and by_category the products, sellers and the lowest price from 1 unit (from_unit_cents). demand: open public requests, the quantity asked for and,

tools.name: commercebook_request_reach
tools.description: GET /market/intents/reach: before posting, how many sellers a public request in the category would be emailed to (each with a live product there, or watching the category) and how many live products match the quantity and the state. Counts only; no seller is named. No key needed.

tools.name: commercebook_market_shipping_estimate
tools.description: GET /market/lots/{id}/shipping: the lowest and highest shipping of one product to a state, from the seller’s shipping rules (no carrier call). served false means the seller does not ship there; a calculated rule is priced at the quote (commercebook_market_quote). No key needed.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_capabilities
tools.description: GET /seller/capabilities: every seller capability on CommerceBook in one read, grouped as ways_to_offer (a standing offer, price by quantity, quote on request with a private floor, quotes on buyer requests, the category watch, and the planned private offers, auctions with a reserve, group buys and p

tools.name: commercebook_whoami
tools.description: Needs a buyer key (no activity needed). A seller or warehouse key also reaches it. The member this key belongs to, with verification, counts, the API base and the key prefix.

tools.name: commercebook_me
tools.description: Needs a buyer key (no activity needed). A seller or warehouse key also reaches it. GET /me: your member, its organisation (your company), verification and counts.

tools.name: commercebook_my_standing
tools.description: Needs a buyer key (no activity needed). A seller or warehouse key also reaches it. GET /me/standing: your strikes in 90 and 365 days, fabricated-contact strikes, whether you may post (posting_suspended_until) and your status. Three strikes in 90 days suspend posting for 30 days; five in a year, or t

tools.name: commercebook_openapi
tools.description: Needs a buyer key (no activity needed). A seller or warehouse key also reaches it. GET /openapi.json: the OpenAPI 3.1 document of the warehouse API.

tools.name: commercebook_leads_open
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can read). GET /leads/open: open leads on the exchange, newest first, with the same visibility rules as the app. Filter by service or market (City, ST); a market filter also returns Anywhere leads (location_any). include_own: true adds your own open leads (own: true on

tools.name: commercebook_leads_mine
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can read). GET /leads/mine: the leads you posted, drafts included.

tools.name: commercebook_lead_post
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can act). POST /leads: post a lead from one of your CRM deals (deal_id) or from fields (company_name, need, service, markets or market, price). Send a title (80 characters) and a one-line summary (140) with the need: buyers read them first, and the lead takes generated

tools.name: commercebook_lead_claim
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Payments: Can act). POST /leads/{id}/claim: claims an open lead. A free lead claims at once (payment demo). A priced lead with payments configured is paid without a client secret: method balance pays from the member’s balance at once (no processing line), method card charges t

tools.name: commercebook_deals_list
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (CRM: Can read). GET /crm/deals: your CRM deals, most recently updated first.

tools.name: commercebook_deal_create
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (CRM: Can act). POST /crm/deals: a new CRM deal; name is required. Also Add a lead on the Leads screen: contact_name, email and phone write the contact, markets (City, ST) or location_any keep the locations, and then_share (true, or the commercebook_lead_post fields) posts the

tools.name: commercebook_deal_update
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (CRM: Can act). PATCH /crm/deals/{id}: change the named fields of a deal. A stage change runs the board rules.

tools.name: commercebook_capacity_list
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Capacity: Can read). GET /capacity/requests: the requests you sent and the ones your node received.

tools.name: commercebook_capacity_request
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Capacity: Can act). POST /capacity/requests: ask another warehouse (node_id from commercebook_members, or its member_id) for pallet positions over a date range.

tools.name: commercebook_capacity_quote
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Capacity: Can act). POST /capacity/requests/{id}/quote: quote a request your node received.

tools.name: commercebook_threads_list
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Messages: Can read). GET /messages/threads: your message threads.

tools.name: commercebook_thread_get
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Messages: Can read). GET /messages/threads/{id}: one thread with its messages, oldest first.

tools.name: commercebook_message_send
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Messages: Can act). POST /messages/threads/{id}: send a message in an open thread.

tools.name: commercebook_message_request
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Messages: Can act). POST /messages/request: the first message to a member opens a thread they accept in the app. An existing open or requested thread is returned instead.

tools.name: commercebook_prices
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Costs: Can read). GET /costs/prices: your invoiced items against the network quotes, as the app computes them.

tools.name: commercebook_members
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (no activity needed). GET /network/members: the directory, public fields only, with each member’s node id.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_me
tools.description: Needs a seller key (no activity needed). GET /seller/me: your seller, what blocks selling (blockers), readiness and counts.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_lots
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Catalog: Can read). GET /seller/catalog/lots: your products (lots in the API), newest first, with state (live, held for paused, draft, stale, sold_out), quantities, price and completeness.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_lot_get
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Catalog: Can read). GET /seller/catalog/lots/{id}: the product record an agent reads, with its manifest, offers and ledger rows.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_catalog_upsert
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Catalog: Can act). POST /seller/catalog/upsert: up to 500 records of the CommerceBook product data template v1.1 (ACP field names: item_id, title, description, brand, category, condition, price, currency, availability, inventory_quantity, inventory_as_of, image_link, enable_check

tools.name: commercebook_seller_lot_hold
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Catalog: Can act). POST /seller/catalog/lots/{id}/hold: pauses the product’s live offers until you resume sales.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_lot_release
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Catalog: Can act). POST /seller/catalog/lots/{id}/release: resumes sales of a paused product on the market through the publish checks (you must be live).

tools.name: commercebook_seller_reconcile
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Catalog: Can read). GET /seller/catalog/reconcile: the stock problems of your products against the count on record at the warehouse that ships them, and the stale counts (a count is stale when it is older than 72 hours): count_mismatch, stale_count, oversold, offer_exceeds_stock,

tools.name: commercebook_seller_verify
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Catalog: Can act). POST /seller/catalog/verify: after a physical count matched, every product keeps its quantity on hand as the count, and now becomes its count date.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_orders
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Orders: Can read). GET /seller/orders: orders of your products, newest first.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_order_get
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Orders: Can read). GET /seller/orders/{id}: the order with payment, fulfillment, disputes, refunds and transitions.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_order_release
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Orders: Can act). POST /seller/orders/{id}/release: releases an authorised order to ship. A shipped order over $500 needs evidence (the count and at least one photo link), else 409 release_evidence_required. You are paid 2 business days after delivery unless a dispute is open; sh

tools.name: commercebook_seller_order_ship
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Orders: Can act). POST /seller/orders/{id}/ship: marks a released order shipped (with carrier and tracking) or picked up. buy_label true (SPEC-67) buys the label for the quoted service at the live price from your balance instead, and writes the carrier and tracking (label_url: a

tools.name: commercebook_seller_order_cancel
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Orders: Can act). POST /seller/orders/{id}/cancel: cancels an order before release; the payment is voided.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_disputes
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Orders: Can read). GET /seller/disputes: disputes on your orders.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_dispute_reply
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Orders: Can act). POST /seller/disputes/{id}/reply: your note and evidence (tracking, photo links) on an open dispute.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_policies_get
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Policies: Can read). GET /seller/policies: acceptance_days (the business days a buyer has to file a dispute, as the policy states it), returns, restocking fee, the lowest price you accept (offer_floor_pct), auctions.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_policies_update
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Policies: Can act). PATCH /seller/policies: the named fields only. Accepting the policies is the owner’s own step in the app.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_statement
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Payouts: Can read). GET /seller/payouts/statement: proceeds after the fee, refund reversals, fee and processing lines by order (90 days by default).

tools.name: commercebook_seller_performance
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Performance: Can read). GET /seller/performance: the seller sheet, live, with the counts behind every rate.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_delegations
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Delegations: Can read). GET /seller/delegations: your warehouse agreements (delegations in the API) with the warehouses that store and ship for you, and their status.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_delegation_request
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Delegations: Can act). POST /seller/delegations: asks a warehouse on CommerceBook for a warehouse agreement to store and ship your goods; it answers from its own account.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_events
tools.description: Needs a seller key (no activity needed). GET /seller/events: what happened on your account, newest first, and whether your agent did it.

tools.name: commercebook_lead_get
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can read). GET /leads/{id}: one lead as the exchange shows it, with quality: the lead quality score (0 to 9), what is present, and on your own lead what is missing.

tools.name: commercebook_lead_buy
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Payments: Can act). POST /leads/{id}/buy: buys a lead within the money limits on the key; over a limit the answer is needs_approval with the approval_id the owner sees. In Stripe test mode payment_method (pm_card_visa) confirms the card payment at once. A priced lead needs the

tools.name: commercebook_lead_withdraw
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can act). POST /leads/{id}/withdraw: takes your draft or open lead off the exchange, until a buyer claims it.

tools.name: commercebook_lead_places
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can act). PATCH /leads/{id}/places: how many buyers may buy your lead (1 makes it exclusive).

tools.name: commercebook_lead_price
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can act). PATCH /leads/{id}/price: the flat price in cents of your draft or open lead, before any buyer claims it (0 is a free lead).

tools.name: commercebook_lead_text
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can act). PATCH /leads/{id}/text: the title (80 characters), the one-line summary (140) and where the lead came from (lead_source own or referral, referral_source the lead company) of your draft or open lead. Fields left out stay as they are; the title and the summary m

tools.name: commercebook_lead_update
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can act). PATCH /leads/{id}: adds details to your draft or open lead before any buyer claims it (409 lead_has_claims after one): product, current_provider (a buyer sees it after purchase), inbound_mode (parcel, pallet, container), units_per_order, rate_expectation (the

tools.name: commercebook_lead_introduction
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can act). POST /leads/{id}/introduction: sends the introduction to the buyers of your lead.

tools.name: commercebook_lead_call
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can act). POST /leads/{id}/call: schedules the call with the buyers of your lead (at: ISO 8601 with zone).

tools.name: commercebook_lead_rate
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can act). POST /leads/{id}/rating: rates a lead you bought as_described or overstated, once.

tools.name: commercebook_lead_challenge
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can act). POST /leads/{id}/challenge: challenges a listing that duplicates your prospect, with evidence.

tools.name: commercebook_claims_list
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can read). GET /leads/claims: the leads you bought, newest first.

tools.name: commercebook_claim_outcome
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can act). POST /leads/claims/{id}/outcome: records what happened with a lead you bought.

tools.name: commercebook_claim_defect
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Leads: Can act). POST /leads/claims/{id}/defect: reports a problem with a lead you bought, within 7 days of buying it. kind is email_bounced, phone_invalid, already_client, duplicate, never_asked or fabricated (a contact that does not exist), the six refund reasons; fabricated

tools.name: commercebook_deal_get
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (CRM: Can read). GET /crm/deals/{id}: one deal with its notes.

tools.name: commercebook_deal_delete
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (CRM: Can act). DELETE /crm/deals/{id}: deletes an archived deal (archive it first with commercebook_deal_update). A GoHighLevel deal is not deleted: it is archived and hidden from the Leads table (hidden true), archived or not before, because GoHighLevel keeps the opportunity;

tools.name: commercebook_deal_note_add
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (CRM: Can act). POST /crm/deals/{id}/notes: adds a note to a deal.

tools.name: commercebook_crm_import
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (CRM: Can act). POST /crm/import: imports deals from CSV text (the CRM sample columns; HubSpot style names are renamed) or rows; dry_run returns what would be created.

tools.name: commercebook_capacity_accept
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Capacity: Can act). POST /capacity/requests/{id}/accept: accepts the quote on a request you sent; a contract record, nothing is paid.

tools.name: commercebook_capacity_quote_withdraw
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Capacity: Can act). POST /capacity/requests/{id}/quote/withdraw: takes back a quote your node gave, before it is accepted.

tools.name: commercebook_capacity_request_withdraw
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Capacity: Can act). POST /capacity/requests/{id}/withdraw: withdraws a capacity request you sent, while it is requested or quoted; once accepted it answers capacity_state.

tools.name: commercebook_thread_respond
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Messages: Can act). POST /messages/threads/{id}/respond: accepts or ignores a message request.

tools.name: commercebook_thread_read
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Messages: Can act). POST /messages/threads/{id}/read: marks a thread read.

tools.name: commercebook_thread_mute
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Messages: Can act). POST /messages/threads/{id}/mute: mutes or unmutes a thread.

tools.name: commercebook_thread_report
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Messages: Can act). POST /messages/threads/{id}/report: reports a thread or one message to CommerceBook.

tools.name: commercebook_member_block
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Messages: Can act). POST /messages/members/{id}/block: blocks or unblocks a member.

tools.name: commercebook_group_create
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Messages: Can act). POST /messages/groups: starts a group with two or more members you already message.

tools.name: commercebook_attachables
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Messages: Can read). GET /messages/attachables: your leads, deals, facilities and capacity requests as attachment cards for a message.

tools.name: commercebook_unread_count
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Messages: Can read). GET /messages/unread: how many messages wait unread.

tools.name: commercebook_member_get
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (no activity needed). GET /network/members/{id}: one member’s public card with facilities, node, rate card and record.

tools.name: commercebook_delegations
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Network: Can read). GET /network/delegations: sellers asking your warehouse for a warehouse agreement (a delegation in the API) to store and ship their goods.

tools.name: commercebook_delegation_respond
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Network: Can act). POST /network/delegations/{id}/respond: accepts or declines a seller’s request for a warehouse agreement.

tools.name: commercebook_delegation_end
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Network: Can act). POST /network/delegations/{id}/end: ends a warehouse agreement; the products stored under it stop selling.

tools.name: commercebook_settings_get
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Settings: Can read). GET /settings: your phone, who sees it and how you hear about messages.

tools.name: commercebook_settings_contact
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Settings: Can act). PATCH /settings/contact: changes the phone (null clears it), its visibility (members, public, hidden) or message notifications (immediate, daily, none).

tools.name: commercebook_agent_limits
tools.description: Needs a buyer key (no activity needed). A seller or warehouse key also reaches it. GET /agent/limits: the money ceilings and approval areas on this key, today’s spend and the approvals not yet used.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_entity_get
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Business details: Can read). GET /seller/entity: your business details, what they still need and readiness.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_entity_update
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Business details: Can act). PATCH /seller/entity: sets fields of the business details (legal_name, entity_type, ein, address, responsible person, beneficial_owners, w9_status).

tools.name: commercebook_seller_fulfillment
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Business details: Can act). PATCH /seller/fulfillment: who ships your orders, self (ship_from, cutoff_local HH:MM, carriers) or warehouse; with warehouse_member_id the request for a warehouse agreement goes out too.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_policies_accept
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Policies: Can act). POST /seller/policies/accept: always refused with 403 owner_accepts_policies. An agent never accepts the policies for the owner; the owner accepts them in person on the seller portal.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_delegation_warehouses
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Delegations: Can read). GET /seller/delegations/warehouses: verified warehouses that can store and ship your goods.

tools.name: commercebook_seller_delegation_end
tools.description: Needs a seller key (Delegations: Can act). POST /seller/delegations/{id}/end: ends your warehouse agreement with a warehouse.

tools.name: commercebook_profile_get
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can read). GET /profile: About and its source, services, people, certifications, the logo, the phone and who sees it.

tools.name: commercebook_service_catalog
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can read). GET /profile/services/catalog: the standard services a profile can list, by key.

tools.name: commercebook_profile_completeness
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can read). GET /profile/completeness: the ten items of the Home meter with the next call for each gap.

tools.name: commercebook_profile_about
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). PATCH /profile/about: writes the About paragraph (up to 1,200 characters; null clears it).

tools.name: commercebook_profile_services
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). PATCH /profile/services: replaces the services list in order: {catalog_key} for a standard service, {id?, title, body} for a custom one (6 custom at most).

tools.name: commercebook_profile_people
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). PATCH /profile/people: replaces the people list (three at most, in order); keep a person by id, add a photo by photo_url.

tools.name: commercebook_profile_person_add
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). POST /profile/people: adds one person after the others, with a photo by photo_url or photo_base64.

tools.name: commercebook_profile_certifications
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). PATCH /profile/certifications: replaces the certifications and systems (12 at most).

tools.name: commercebook_profile_contact
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). PATCH /profile/contact: changes the profile phone (null clears it) and who sees it (members, public, hidden).

tools.name: commercebook_profile_logo
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). POST /profile/logo: adds or replaces the logo from url or content_base64 (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

tools.name: commercebook_profile_logo_remove
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). DELETE /profile/logo: removes the logo; the profile shows the initial mark.

tools.name: commercebook_rate_card_get
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can read). GET /profile/rate-card: the rate card as published on your node.

tools.name: commercebook_rate_card_set
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). PATCH /profile/rate-card: publishes up to four lines, each optional (cents): storage per pallet per month, receiving per pallet, pick and pack per order, projects per hour, shown as from prices. A number sets a line, null clears it; at least one line must re

tools.name: commercebook_facilities_list
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can read). GET /facilities: your facilities with their photos, video and pins.

tools.name: commercebook_facility_create
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). POST /facilities: adds a facility and places its pin from the street address (city centre when the address does not resolve).

tools.name: commercebook_facility_update
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). PATCH /facilities/{id}: changes the named fields; a changed address places the pin again.

tools.name: commercebook_facility_delete
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). DELETE /facilities/{id}: removes a facility and its stored files; cannot be undone.

tools.name: commercebook_facility_pin
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). POST /facilities/{id}/pin: places the pin again from the address (retry asks the map service again).

tools.name: commercebook_facility_media_add
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). POST /facilities/{id}/media: adds a photo (10 at most) or the video (1): url as a link, or store true, or content_base64 to store the file.

tools.name: commercebook_facility_media_order
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). PATCH /facilities/{id}/media: lists every photo and the video once in the new order, with any caption changes.

tools.name: commercebook_facility_media_remove
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Profile: Can act). DELETE /facilities/media/{id}: removes one photo or the video; cannot be undone.

tools.name: commercebook_costs_rank
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Costs: Can read). GET /costs/rank: your rank and the network median per category, the categories above the median and the top overspends.

tools.name: commercebook_costs_summary
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Costs: Can read). GET /costs/summary: the invoices read this month and the biggest saving on Your Prices, with its next step (the spend line of My Costs).

tools.name: commercebook_price_match
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Costs: Can act). POST /costs/prices/match: records the price your vendor matched for an item of Your Prices (item_key), or the refusal.

tools.name: commercebook_invoices_list
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Costs: Can read). GET /costs/invoices: your invoices and how each was read.

tools.name: commercebook_invoice_upload
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Costs: Can act). POST /costs/invoices: uploads an invoice from url or content_base64 (with filename) and reads it into Your Prices (parse false skips the read).

tools.name: commercebook_invoice_parse
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Costs: Can act). POST /costs/invoices/{id}/parse: reads an invoice again; its lines are replaced.

tools.name: commercebook_invoice_delete
tools.description: Needs a warehouse key (Costs: Can act). DELETE /costs/invoices/{id}: deletes an invoice, its lines and its file; cannot be undone.

tools.name: commercebook_quote_requests
